localmaxxing.notes: Gemma 4 31B (abliterated v2), 4-bit affine gs64 decoder; vision tower + embed/lm_head bf16 per config. MLX MTP speculative decoding via mlx-vlm, official gemma-4-31B-it-assistant drafter, draft-block-size 4 (optimum on this build). Measured on M5 Pro 48GB, macOS 26.5, greedy temp 0. tokSOut = median of 4 timed iterations (range 32.8-35.5), decode throughput over the inter-token window (completion_tokens / (t_last-t_first)) from the OpenAI-compatible stream; ~250-tok code workload, exact usage.completion_tokens. Drafter acceptance ~69.8%, ~3.09 accepted tok/round. Byte-identical to dense greedy (fast-verify patch adds the missing gemma4 speculative_argmax_from_hidden hook: one batched norm->lm_head->softcap over K+1 positions). Speedup vs dense 4-bit (~15 tok/s, ~94% of the 276 GB/s measured-bandwidth ceiling) ~2.2x. peakVramGb is process phys_footprint_peak and includes MLX's Metal buffer cache growing under a 36GB wired limit; true resident weights+drafter+KV ~= 18-20GB (steady footprint 26.5GB). wheel: mlx qmv_wide (PR #3764) built from git main; without it b3 tops out ~24.6 tok/s. Model repo public; base jdfelo/gemma-4-31B-v2 is gated.
